public_comment.speaker_as_heard: Greg Le frer, 15 Park Street Terrace
public_comment.topic: Asked where the projected 5-10 year maintenance plan for Marshall Park is, and who will maintain what once phases are complete. Youth baseball and softball have carried that burden so far.
Linked user fees to the cost of maintaining new facilities, which will cost more than the old fields to maintain.
Said youth baseball and softball brings over 5,000 visitors to the parks and asked for consideration and communication.
Said the user fee conversation came up when the field-use notification was voted on. Argued the commission should analyze maintenance across all parks, and asked about capital plans for other parks.
Said youth sports feel pushed out in town, with football, baseball and softball all affected. Asked for understanding of recreational sports.
Asked when field maintenance allocations will be known. Questioned whether Parks is responsible only for big design projects and who handles repairs.
Asked whether the schools pay to use the ball fields, whether pickleball users would be charged, and who handles toilets and trash.
Said the fields are already degraded and asked what backend plan accompanies any user fee increase. Questioned whether punch lists should go through Parks or the facilities director.
Asked that the town consider long-standing cultural groups such as youth baseball and softball, which bring many visitors. Said they feel brushed aside.
Asked why ARPA money is being returned to the town while the parks have many needs. The chair explained the funds were granted for this purpose and must be under contract by year end.
